title: Allahu Akbar haye mera sona akbar
body:
allah o akbar haye mera sona akbar
aaj aakhri dede aza , aaj aakhri dede aza
tujh pe yeh pidar qurbaan
1. aaj aye hum shakl-e-rasool allah
jaag utthe dasht-e-karbobala
islam na bhoolega
ta hashr yeh teri aza
<<DIVIDER>>
2. haiya ala qairil amal ki sada
aye akbar hoor jab sunlega
jal uthegi shamm-e-yaqee
chatt jayega wahmo guma
<<DIVIDER>>
3. har waqt machalta rahta hai
abbas ki aankhon mein dariya
agaaz-e-moharram se
be chain hain ammu jaan
<<DIVIDER>>
4. hum log bacha kar laaye hai
maqtal se nova-e-ill allah
hulkhoom mein burida se
karna hain yahi elaan
<<DIVIDER>>
5. zakhmo ka sehra bandhwa kar
ab maut se rishta karlea
beta teri maa ko hai
teri shadi ka armaan
<<DIVIDER>>
6. ab haq ke qabiley walon
ko milan hai gale talwaron se
aaj aal-e-mohammed mein
hogi eid-e-qurban
<<DIVIDER>>
7. duniya mein musalma naam ke hain
zehnon ke andhere shaam ke hain
teri roop ke kirno se
roshan hain yeh sara jahan
<<DIVIDER>>
8. kya dekh sakenge qalil-ullah
ghash khajayenge zabi-ullah
tere sinaye zaqmi se
jab khenchona nok-e-sina
